description: The Basel Rathaus is the red town hall on the Marktplatz, with an arcade along the square and the tall tower added in the 1898–1904 enlargement. It stands in the old town, away from the Rhine front, so this frame is not the Minster and not the Mittlere Brücke. No coat of arms is readable. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast and breezy, with no rain.
